notes.title: Possible FPS Bug Fix
notes.content: User reported bad FPS in the game, despite being well over specs. Seeing if this will fix the FPS drops.

notes.title: Cyber Sprint Full Release Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

It's here! The full release of Cyber Sprint is now available for all Steam users to buy the full game and play it right now!

Cyber Sprint contains 16 levels each one harder than the last. The goal is to beat the ame as fast you can, and replay each level to achieve a 3 star rating and beat your best time!

Speedruns will be up on speedrun.com as soon as it's approved. Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far, and all future supporters as well. Happy speedrunning!

notes.title: Cyber Sprint Release Date!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

I will not waste your time anymore than needed, but I am very happy and excited to announce that the game will be fully released and playable on [b]January 10th![/b]

That's all, that's the announcement. Have a great day!

notes.title: Thanks for playing the demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/9fd2bcfe2e8fb4dceaeaff598222bc089ff12238.png[/img]

Big shoutout to everyone who took time out of their day to spend it playing my demo. I am very thankful and appreciate it! As I get the full release ready for December, I am really excited to show everyone the final product and the changes and updates I've made.

Look forward to you playing the final release!

notes.title: Cyber Sprint Demo Is Officially Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]
I am happy to announce that the demo for Cyber Sprint is officially live! You may now download it on the Steam store page and compete against other players for the best time! Be be sure to check out the website at cybersprintgame.com and wishlist for the full release!

I will not waste anymore of your time, so get to speedrunning!

notes.title: Demo Release In Under 3 Days!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

Hello once again fellow Speedrunners! I am happy to announce Valve has verified the demo, and it's set to release on time, on November 14th! That's just in 3 days!

I am really looking forward to your feedback, and am even more excited to see just how many of your find creative ways to beat (break) the game. If the demo works out well enough, there is hope the game could fully release sometime this December. Maybe an early Christmas gift?

The demo consists of the first 5 levels of the game, so there is plenty of gameplay for you to get a proper feel of the game. 

Don't forget to wishlist if you're interested, and check out my website! cybersprintgame.com

notes.title: Playable Demo + Contest With Prize Pool!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

🎃🏃‍♂️Welcome once again speedrunners! Hope everyone is having a great Halloween, and an ever better day! I wanted to take this time to announce that the playable demo for Cyber Sprint and a contest with a $50 prize pool will be live November 14th!

You can check out the official countdown at cybersprintgame.com 
All rules and instructions on how to enter will also go live on that same website once the deadline has been reached.

[b]The Demo will consist of the first 5 levels of the game, with most features at hand and ready to demo. All content in this demo is liable to change, but is on the most part pretty complete.

The contest will be a simple speedrunning competition where the player with the fastest time to beat the demo will be awarded $50. Plans to host monthly contests like this with even bigger prize pools at in the future as well, but be sure not to miss this demo![/b]

Please consider sharing this with your friends, as the more people that enter will let me gauge the interest and make the prize pools even bigger next time. 

Thank you so much for reading, and enjoy your Halloween! 🎉

notes.title: Cyber Sprint Demo COMING SOON
notes.content:
Exciting news! I am currently working on getting Cyber Sprint's demo to release within the next 30 days. The demo will include the first 4 levels, and release with most mechanics that appear up until that point. 

Accompanying the demo, there will be a monthly speedrun competition starting the moment the demo releases. For a start, I will be offering a $50 prize pool for the fastest time. 

If you want to be updated when the competitions start, as long as the rules be sure to check out my website at cybersprintgame.com

Thank you all for the support!
